gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with TAI MONG TSAI ROAD near Wong Chuk Wan and running in a north-easterly direction for about 150 metres where it turns to run in a north-westerly direction for about 375 metres before bending to run in a northerly direction for about 360 metres; it then bends to run generally in a west north-westerly direction for about 700 metres where it turns to run in a north-westerly direction for about 400 metres and then bends again to run in a west north-westerly direction for about 230 metres; it continues to run in a generally northerly direction for about 350 metres before it curves to run in a west north-westerly direction for about 610 metres where it bends again to run generally in a northerly direction for about 800 metres; it then turns to run in a north-westerly direction for about 280 metres and then bends to run in a north north-westerly direction for about 750 metres before it turns to run in a west north-westerly direction for about 480 metres where it terminates at its closed end near Sai O Village as shown coloured red on Plan No. SKRM 1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與黃竹灣附近之大網仔路交界起，向東北伸展約一百五十米，再向西北伸展約三百七十五米，後轉向北伸展約三百六十米，再向西北偏西伸展約七百米，後轉向西北伸展約四百米，再向西北偏西伸展約二百三十米，後轉向北伸展約三百五十米，再向西北偏西伸展約六百一十米，後轉向北伸展約八百米，再向西北伸展約二百八十米，後轉向西北偏北伸展約七百五十米，再向西北偏西伸展約四百八十米，然後在西澳村附近終止。在 SKRM 1 號圖則上以紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with an unnamed road near Sha Ha and running in a north-westerly direction for about 65 metres where it bends to run in a north-easterly direction for about 70 metres; it then turns to run generally in a north north-westerly direction for about 800 metres before it bends to run in a westerly direction for about 140 metres where it turns to run in a north north-easterly direction for about 160 metres; it continues to run in a westerly direction for about 170 metres before it turns to run generally in a northerly direction for about 300 metres and then bends to run generally in a north-westerly direction for about 720 metres where it terminates near Wong Chuk Yeung Village as shown coloured yellow on Plan No. SKRM 1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與沙下附近之一條未命名路交界起，向西北伸展約六十五米，後轉向東北伸展約七十米，再向西北偏北伸展約八百米，後轉向西伸展約一百四十米，再向東北偏北伸展約一百六十米，後轉向西伸展約一百七十米，再向北伸展約三百米，後轉向西北伸展約七百二十米，然後在黃竹洋村附近終止。在 SKRM 1 號圖則上以黃色標明。
